project_type: Vite + React 18 SPA (TypeScript), Firebase (Auth + Firestore), PWA via vite-plugin-pwa, Tailwind CSS, framer-motion, react-i18next, zustand, react-router-dom v6
build_system: Vite 5 + tsc. 'npm run build' = tsc && vite build. 'npm run lint' = tsc --noEmit (no ESLint configured). Path alias '@/' maps to 'src/'.
test_framework: None — no test runner configured. Verification is build-time type checking via 'npm run lint' (tsc --noEmit) and 'npm run build'.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run lint' (tsc --noEmit) — must exit 0 with no errors. 2. Run 'npm run build' — must exit 0 and produce dist/ without errors. These are the only automated checks in this project.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell workspace. Do NOT run 'npm run dev' or touch the dev server. The .env file exists locally (not committed). .env.example IS committed.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code conventions: functional React components, TypeScript enums for roles/statuses, useTranslation for all user-visible strings, framer-motion for card animations, Tailwind utility classes only (no custom CSS files).
key_patterns: 1. UserRole enum in src/types/index.ts — add new roles here first. 2. useOrders hook (src/hooks/useOrders.ts) branches on role string to pick Firestore query strategy. 3. ServeurDashboard.tsx is the canonical dashboard pattern to replicate: header gradient, left panel with table list, right panel with grouped orders, sound notification on new orders. 4. OrderActions.tsx currently owns all order status transitions; it will be split by role prop. 5. seedAccounts.ts reads passwords from import.meta.env VITE_SEED_*_PASSWORD env vars. 6. i18n keys live in src/i18n/fr.json and en.json — both must be updated together. 7. Firestore rules: orders already allow update by any authenticated user, so no security rule change is strictly required.
directory_structure: src/pages/{serveur,cuisine,admin,client}/ — one folder per role. src/components/{serveur,admin,shared,ui}/ — components by domain. src/hooks/ — custom hooks. src/store/ — zustand stores. src/lib/ — firebase init + firestore helpers. src/seed/ — browser-side demo account seeder. src/i18n/ — translation JSON files. scripts/ — Node admin SDK seed script. .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (never committed).
